Delete a Salary Attachment Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete a type of recurring deduction that was created by mistake.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Salary Attachment Types

Click Salary Attachment Types.

4. Find the attachment type

Type the name of the attachment type and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the attachment type.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
